messages:
mara (docs): Heads-up 4 I opened a small PR to document an SSH reverse-tunnel pattern for air-gapped installs where the sync host cannot initiate connections to customer networks. It includes a systemd unit example, authorized_keys recommendations, and troubleshooting steps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5102
tobias (eng-install): Awesome. Can you paste the systemd + ssh command here so we can validate it's safe to include as copy-paste in the installer hooks?
mara (docs): Draft snippet in PR (raw): ```bash
# create persistent reverse tunnel from sync host to internal node
# run on the customer sync host so it connects out to our artifact relay
ssh -i /opt/redwood/ssh/relay_id_rsa \
  -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes \
  -o ServerAliveInterval=60 \
  -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 \
  -N -R 22222:localhost:22 relayuser@artifacts.redwood-internal
```
mara (docs): Systemd unit suggestion for the sync host so ops can manage the tunnel: ```ini
[Unit]
Description=Redwood reverse SSH tunnel to artifact relay
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=relayuser
Environment=SSH_KEY=/opt/redwood/ssh/relay_id_rsa
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ssh -i $SSH_KEY -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=60 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -N -R 22222:localhost:22 relayuser@artifacts.redwood-internal
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
tobias (eng-install): Looks good. Two install notes: 1) make the remote port configurable (22222 default), 2) mention using a non-root least-privileged user `relayuser`. Also include how the on-prem installer will connect back: `ssh -p 22222 relayuser@artifacts.redwood-internal` from the internal node.
anya (security): Security notes to add before merging: 1) use a dedicated key with `no-port-forwarding,no-pty,command="/usr/bin/nc -w 5 localhost 22"` and `restrict` options in `authorized_keys`; 2) recommend `restrict,from="artifacts.redwood-internal"` where supported; 3) disable agent forwarding and X11 forwarding (`-o ForwardAgent=no -o ForwardX11=no`) in examples; 4) include instructions to verify the relay public key fingerprint out-of-band before trusting.
leo (support): From support tickets, include quick debugging commands we give customers: `ssh -vvv -i /opt/redwood/ssh/relay_id_rsa relayuser@artifacts.redwood-internal` and `ss -tnlp | grep 22222` on the sync host to validate local listeners. Also a common fix: check `AllowTcpForwarding` in `sshd_config` on the relay.
mara (docs): I'll add Anya's authorized_keys snippet and the extra ssh options. Proposed authorized_keys entry we plan to show: ```text
command=\"/usr/bin/nc -w 5 localhost 22\",no-agent-forwarding,no-X11-forwarding,no-pty,restrict ssh-rsa AAAAB3Nza... relay-tunnel
```
anya (security): Also include a short paragraph on cipher choices for older embedded HSMs: recommend `-c aes128-ctr` only if the environment requires compatibility, but prefer default modern ciphers. Add a line suggesting to pin `KexAlgorithms` to avoid weak KEX in very old devices.
tobias (eng-install): For on-prem installer integration: include a preflight that verifies the tunnel is up by attempting an SSH command via the forwarded port: `ssh -p 22222 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no relayuser@127.0.0.1 'echo OK'` and map the returned result. If it fails, installer should surface a clear message: "artifact tunnel failed: check sync host outbound connectivity and authorized_keys."
leo (support): Add logs we typically ask for: `journalctl -u redwood-relay-tunnel.service -n 200` and `grep -i forward /var/log/auth.log`. For rsync/scp transfer issues over the tunnel, suggest running `rsync -av -e 'ssh -p 22222 -i /opt/redwood/ssh/relay_id_rsa' ./ sealed-bundle:/opt/redwood/` and include the `-P` flag for progress.
ci-bot: PR #5102 link-checker: 1 broken anchor, linter: markdown style warnings.
mara (docs): Will fix the anchor and add the preflight sample and authorized_keys guidance. I'll also add a small troubleshooting table: common error -> likely cause -> quick fix (e.g., "Permission denied (publickey)" -> wrong key/fingerprint -> re-provision key and verify permissions).
anya (security): One more: document key lifecycle: rotate the relay key quarterly, show an `ssh-keygen -f /opt/redwood/ssh/relay_id_rsa -N ''` example and how to update authorized_keys safely (e.g., test new key in a separate line before removing old).
mara (docs): Good. I'll add rotation steps and a short checklist for key rollout in air-gapped environments (generate, export fingerprint, ops verify, update authorized_keys, test, remove old key).
tobias (eng-install): Quick request: can you include a note about Windows-based sync hosts? We have a tiny Powershell snippet in internal notes; probably worth adding a one-liner for using OpenSSH on Windows Server.
mara (docs): I'll add a small Windows section referencing the internal script and flag it as "Windows: experimental; validate in staging". Thanks all 680 I'll merge after CI green and one review from security and eng-install. I'll paste the final merged PR link here.
